unit.why: A memorate quoted from Zohar Hai by R. Yitzhak Isaac of Komarno: he watched R. Avraham Yehoshua Heschel of Apta speak with a widow about the exile of the Shekhinah, and R. Zvi of Zhidachov could not sleep after hearing a story from him.

stories.start_quote: בזהר חי ממו״ר הרה״ק מוהרי״א מקאמרנא
stories.summary_en: The Komarner recalls how the Apter Rav spoke with a widow in deep wisdom about the Shekhinah's exile until both wept, and how a Friday-night story the Apter told kept R. Zvi of Zhidachov pacing awake all night because of its depth and secrets.
